report.summary: tests/test_adapters.py: Tests for adapters including SubprocessAdapter profiles, custom sessions, transport record round-trip, and event dataclass instantiation. daedalus/providers/base.py: Defines ProviderCapabilities dataclass and Provider abstract base class with abstract methods available and run, and a helper _enforce_read_only. daedalus/langgraph_adapter.py: Provides langgraph availability check and deferred graph building function.
risks: CLAIMS|daedalus/providers/base.py|ProviderCapabilities: "What a provider is *allowed* and *able* to do. These are structural guarantees enforced by the harness, not promises the model must keep."
CLAIMS|daedalus/providers/base.py|Provider: "Common interface for every model backend. All providers return the same validated ``agent_report_v1`` dict so everything downstream is uniform."

CLAIMS|daedalus/langgraph_adapter.py|build_graph: "The stdlib harness keeps the state contract small and serializable. This adapter is intentionally thin so a future LangGraph graph can reuse the same state keys instead of inventing a second orchestration model."
